title: LWA S2 modpack
description: This mod-pack upgrades both visuals and gameplay to give players the best possible experience on the fun and welcoming Le Wynn After server!
body:
# What is the LWA Server ?
It a server created by four friends for the purpose of enjoying minecraft with each other. The server has steadily grown to about fifteen active players and is welcoming to anyone who seems to be a geniune minecraft lover. The server has hosted multiple events from categories such as PVP, exploration, board games in minecraft, community builds, etc. 

# Why the mod pack ?
This mod pack is essential for the best possible experience on the Le Wynn After server. It combines powerful performance mods like Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, ModernFix, and Concurrent Chunk Management Engine to dramatically improve FPS, reduce lag, and optimize memory usage. Visual enhancements such as Distant Horizons, Better Clouds, Particle Rain, Visuality, LambDynamicLights, and Immersive Winds make the world feel more alive and immersive without sacrificing performance.

## Advantages for all the GoodTimesWithScar's and Mumbo Jumbo's:
For builders and technical players, tools like Litematica, WorldEdit, MiniHUD, Tweakeroo, Accurate Block Placement Reborn, Syncmatica, and Litematica Server Paster provide precision, efficiency, and large-scale project support. 

## Quality of life featues:
The mod-pack includes VoxelMap, BetterF3, Status Effect Bars, Chat Animation, Mouse Tweaks, Logical Zoom, and Screenshot Viewer that make everyday gameplay smoother and more enjoyable.

Together, these mods ensure smoother performance, enhanced visuals, improved building tools, and a more immersive overall experience while remaining fully compatible with the Le Wynn After server.
